statements.text: Assessment: right lumbar radiculopathy at L4-L5 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
CT lumbar spine 08/05/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Pain limits walking to about one block and has forced the patient to stop volunteering; sleep is disrupted most nights.
Baseline NRS prior to any intervention: 7/10.
Symptoms began on 04/06/2026, 22 weeks before this visit.
Completed physical therapy from 04/18/2026 to 05/23/2026 (5 weeks) with no lasting benefit, and failed ibuprofen 600 mg TID.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
Epidural steroid injection history: 2 lumbar injections in the past 12 months (03/05/2026, 05/14/2026).
